activities.description: Leisurely walk on Candolim beach, relax at a beachside spot (choose a pure-veg beach café or bring snacks). Low-key evening to adjust to Goa tempo.

meals.place: On the train / station vegetarian eatery
Pure-veg restaurant near Candolim (suggest asking hotel reception for current pure-veg options)
meals.cuisine: Indian vegetarian (local Goan-style vegetarian + North/South Indian)

days.notes: Take it easy first evening — long dinner and early night if needed.

days.theme: Old Goa & Panjim — culture, cafés and Portuguese quarter
days.weather: Hot and sunny (tMax 36°C) — morning and late afternoon are best for walking.

activities.name: Visit Old Goa: Museum of Christian Art & Museum of Goa
activities.description: Short, relaxed visits to two nearby museums in Old Goa. Take breaks in shaded spots; museums provide indoor respite from midday heat.

activities.name: Panjim & Fontainhas (Latin Quarter) stroll + Panjim city viewpoint
activities.description: Drive to Panjim, wander the colorful Fontainhas area, sip a long coffee at a pure-veg café and visit the Panjim city viewpoint for river/old-town views.

meals.place: Hotel (Santana Beach Resort) — vegetarian buffet / set
Pure-veg café in Panjim / Old Goa (long relaxed meal)
Pure-veg beachfront or resort restaurant (long dinner)

days.notes: Museums are indoor and good for hottest part of the day. Late lunch / long coffee fits the relaxed pace.

days.theme: Beach morning & departure
days.weather: Hot and sunny (tMax 37.8°C) — morning is best for beach time before the return journey.

activities.name: Morning beach time (Arossim / Candolim depending on preference)
activities.description: Leisurely morning swim or beach rest. Check out mid-day and prepare for departure to the station.

activities.name: Panjim city viewpoint quick stop & transfer to station
activities.description: Short stop at Panjim viewpoint en route to station for photos; then taxi to the railway station for return.

meals.place: Pure-veg eatery near station or packed (before boarding)

days.notes: Plan for comfortable arrival time at station; keep water and sun protection available.

packingTips: Light cotton clothing, hat and sunglasses — Goa will be hot and sunny.
Sunscreen (high SPF) and after-sun lotion.
Swimwear and quick-dry towel for beach time.
Reusable water bottle (stay hydrated).
Power bank, chargers and printed/phone copies of train tickets and hotel booking.
Comfortable sandals and a pair of closed shoes if you plan short walks in Old Goa.
tips: All meals planned are pure-vegetarian — confirm with restaurants on arrival; ask the hotel for pure-veg restaurant recommendations (many local eateries can provide vegetarian thalis).
Keep the hottest hours (12:00–16:00) for indoor activities (museums) or resting at the hotel.
Book train seats well in advance (Feb is a busy season in Goa).
Use app taxis for reliable fares to/from the station; ask the hotel to arrange pickups to avoid waiting.
Carry small cash for beach shacks and tips — some small cafés may be cash-preferred.
